personal_information.title: CompSci Student @ UVA
personal_information.summary: Computer Science & Linguistics Researcher & Ph.D. Applicant specializing in Systems Engineering and Compiler Design. Combines rigorous academic research in low-level architecture with technical expertise in C, x86 Assembly, OCaml, and Python. Specialized in developing efficient computing systems, ranging from custom kernels and bootloaders to full-stack applications supporting 400+ users. Demonstrated leadership in both academic and industrial environments, supporting 600+ students as a Teaching Assistant and leading fabrication teams for high-profile clients including Disney and Princeton University.

education.degree: BA in Computer Science and Linguistics

projects.title: Full-Stack Library Web-App

projects.title: Domain-Specific Graphics Language
details: Designed a custom programming language syntactically optimized for graphics processing emphasizing clarity, modularity, and component-based structure; Integrates procedural and functional programming paradigms
